focus.title: 本周全球经贸主线：出口管制与关税博弈叠加，供应链合规进入深水区
focus.summary: 本周（2026.09.28–10.02）国际经贸主线围绕出口管制、关税调整与供应链审查展开。美国继续收紧对先进半导体、AI算力相关物项的出口许可，并扩大实体清单审查范围；欧盟加速推进关键原材料与绿色技术领域的战略自主，拟对部分进口产品加征碳边境调节机制费用；中国则通过自贸试验区提升战略与跨境服务贸易负面清单，稳定外贸外资基本盘。整体趋势显示，主要经济体正以“国家安全+产业政策”双轮驱动重塑贸易规则，出海企业面临更复杂的合规矩阵，需将出口管制、原产地规则与关税筹划纳入常态化风控。
focus.source: 来源：综合WTO、美国BIS、欧盟委员会、中国商务部本周动态 · 本周
focus.title_en: Weekly Global Trade Focus: Export Controls and Tariff Games Overlap, Supply Chain Compliance Enters Deep Water
focus.summary_en: This week (Sep 28–Oct 2, 2026), the main thread of international trade centered on export controls, tariff adjustments and supply chain reviews. The U.S. continued to tighten export licensing for advanced semiconductors and AI computing items and expanded entity list scrutiny; the EU accelerated strategic autonomy in critical raw materials and green technologies, proposing carbon border adjustment charges on certain imports; China stabilized foreign trade and investment through pilot free trade zone upgrading and a negative list for cross-border services. The overall trend shows major economies are reshaping trade rules via 'national security plus industrial policy', exposing outbound companies to a more complex compliance matrix that requires embedding export controls, rules of origin and tariff planning into routine risk management.
focus.source_en: Source: Compiled from WTO, U.S. BIS, European Commission and China's Ministry of Commerce updates · this week

case.title: 本周案例：境外仲裁裁决在华获承认执行，凸显跨境争议解决路径选择价值
case.summary: 本周，某中国出海企业与欧洲供应商的货物质量争议经新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）裁决后，当事人向中国内地中级人民法院申请承认与执行。法院依据《纽约公约》及中国相关司法解释，审查后认定仲裁程序正当、裁决不违反公共政策，裁定予以承认和执行。该案启示在于：在跨境合同中约定中立地仲裁机构与明确仲裁规则，可显著提升裁决的可执行性；同时企业应重视证据留存与合同条款的精细化设计，避免因程序瑕疵导致执行受阻。对于涉及粤港澳大湾区企业的跨境交易，选择香港仲裁亦可依托内地与香港相互执行仲裁裁决的安排，提高救济效率。
case.source: 来源：中国法院本周涉外仲裁司法审查案例综述
case.title_en: Weekly Case: Foreign Arbitral Award Recognized and Enforced in China, Highlighting Value of Cross-Border Dispute Resolution Choices
case.summary_en: This week, a dispute over goods quality between a Chinese outbound company and a European supplier, after arbitration at the Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC), led the prevailing party to seek recognition and enforcement before an intermediate people's court in mainland China. Applying the New York Convention and relevant judicial interpretations, the court found the arbitral procedure proper and the award not contrary to public policy, and ordered recognition and enforcement. The case underscores that designating a neutral arbitral institution and clear arbitration rules in cross-border contracts can significantly enhance enforceability; companies should also focus on evidence preservation and refined contract drafting to avoid procedural defects. For transactions involving Greater Bay Area enterprises, choosing Hong Kong arbitration can further leverage the mutual enforcement arrangement between the mainland and Hong Kong to improve remedy efficiency.
case.source_en: Source: Weekly review of foreign-related arbitration judicial review cases by Chinese courts

policy.title: 本周政策：中国涉外法治与粤港澳大湾区跨境便利化举措密集落地
policy.summary: 本周，中国在涉外法治与跨境便利化方面释放多项政策信号。商务部等部门继续推进自贸试验区提升战略，在跨境数据流动、跨境服务贸易负面清单等方面开展压力测试；粤港澳大湾区方面，内地与香港、澳门在职业资格互认、跨境商事登记、跨境支付结算等领域推出新便利措施，前海、横琴等合作区进一步优化外商投资准入与跨境法律服务体系。此外，涉外法治人才培养与域外法查明机制持续完善，为企业“走出去”提供制度支撑。总体看，政策导向是在扩大开放的同时强化风险防控，出海企业应关注大湾区先行先试政策带来的合规红利与跨境架构优化空间。
policy.source: 来源：综合中国商务部、粤港澳大湾区相关机构本周政策动态
policy.title_en: Weekly Policy: China's Foreign-Related Rule of Law and GBA Cross-Border Facilitation Measures Intensify
policy.summary_en: This week, China released multiple policy signals on foreign-related rule of law and cross-border facilitation. The Ministry of Commerce and other departments continued to advance the pilot free trade zone upgrading strategy, conducting stress tests on cross-border data flows and the negative list for cross-border services trade. In the Greater Bay Area, the mainland, Hong Kong and Macao introduced new facilitation measures on mutual recognition of professional qualifications, cross-border commercial registration and cross-border payment settlement, while Qianhai and Hengqin cooperation zones further optimized foreign investment access and cross-border legal services. In addition, mechanisms for training foreign-related legal talent and ascertaining foreign law continued to improve, providing institutional support for companies going global. Overall, the policy direction is to expand openness while strengthening risk control; outbound companies should watch for compliance dividends and cross-border structuring opportunities arising from GBA pilot policies.
policy.source_en: Source: Compiled from this week's policy updates by China's Ministry of Commerce and GBA-related authorities

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：出口管制与关税风险交织，出海企业需构建动态合规体系
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：本周国际经贸环境呈现“管制加码、关税分化、供应链重构”三大特征，出海企业面临的不再是单一法律风险，而是出口管制、制裁、关税、数据合规与争议解决的多维叠加。建议企业：一是建立动态合规体系，将出口管制与制裁筛查嵌入采购、销售、物流全流程，定期更新受限清单；二是优化跨境交易架构，合理利用自贸试验区、粤港澳大湾区及RCEP等规则，做好原产地筹划与关税成本测算；三是强化合同条款设计，明确仲裁地、适用法律与合规承诺，降低执行风险。下周需重点关注美国对华半导体与AI领域出口管制细则更新、欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期安排，以及中国涉外法治领域可能出台的新规，建议企业提前开展合规审计与情景演练。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师 · 本周研判
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's Weekly View: Export Controls and Tariff Risks Intertwine, Outbound Companies Need Dynamic Compliance Systems
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's weekly view: This week's international trade environment featured three characteristics—intensified controls, differentiated tariffs and supply chain restructuring. Outbound companies now face not a single legal risk but a multidimensional overlap of export controls, sanctions, tariffs, data compliance and dispute resolution. Recommendations: first, build a dynamic compliance system, embedding export control and sanctions screening into procurement, sales and logistics, and regularly updating restricted lists; second, optimize cross-border transaction structures, reasonably using pilot free trade zones, the Greater Bay Area and RCEP rules for origin planning and tariff cost assessment; third, strengthen contract clause design, specifying arbitration seat, governing law and compliance commitments to reduce enforcement risks. Next week, focus on updates to U.S. export control rules on semiconductors and AI toward China, the EU carbon border adjustment mechanism transitional arrangements, and possible new Chinese foreign-related rule of law regulations. Companies are advised to conduct compliance audits and scenario drills in advance.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Linhao · weekly view
